outcome: Incidence of postpartum hemorrhage (PPH) of > 1000 mL, > 1500 mL and > 2000 mL
cohort: 31,341 women giving birth in Wales in 2017
finding: Implementation of quantitative blood loss measurement in all hospitals providing maternity care in Wales is associated with detection of higher rates of PPH.
mod_finding: The incidence of PPH varied with mode of delivery, with the highest rates observed for instrumental vaginal deliveries and non-elective cesarean sections.
